song.title: Amazing Grace
song.author: John Newton
song.lyrics: [V1] Amazing grace, how sweet the sound That saved a wretch like me I once was lost, but now am found Was blind, but now I see [V2] 'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear And grace my fears relieved How precious did that grace appear The hour I first believed [C] Amazing grace, how sweet the sound That saved a wretch like me
